prompt: Use case: identity-preserve. Deep Orbit cinematic cel-shaded narrative,1536x1024 landscape. First portraits establish fixed canonical identities, facial morphology and age, eyes/nose/jaw, hair, costume and equipment. Next approved room master for ROOM ARCHITECTURE ONLY, not diagrams or colors. Last reference exact restaging target. Restrained clean outlines and muted sage #6BAA8A, aged brass #A89060, charcoal/navy, natural skin, modest practical lights. No glossy or neon lime. Balanced stylized adults with coherent neck/shoulders/torso, plausible arm chains, exactly two five-finger hands each, natural chair/table support. Faces visible, eyes follow work or other crew, candid action and subtle lively emotion, no camera gaze or presentation portrait. Screens physically face actual reader; camera beside reader sees same front face. Every label, cell, line, arrow follows correct surface perspective. Remove outward handheld displays. Peripheral screens inactive. Only specified content, no fake numerical findings or extra diagrams. Farah LEFT and Demir RIGHT sit beside one monitor in an actual collaborative tracing exercise. Demir hand on mouse and other hand relaxed on table. Farah leans in beside him, one hand resting on table and the other touching her chin. He glances at her with an amused aha expression; she looks at third state with pleased concentration. Shared monitor LEFT foreground faces both people and camera samefrontside. Heading "One-unit recurrence". Equation "h = tanh(0.8h + x)". Note "Start h = 0; bias = 0". Table with headers "Input x", "New h" and exactly3rows "0.5 | 0.4621", "0.9 | 0.8537", "0.5 | 0.8284". Footer "Same input, different history". Use clear quiet text and coherent rowperspective, no extradiagrams.

methods: native face crops against canonical portraits
ownReview.readerDirection: Characters and camera are on display front side. Held-out papers/devices removed.
ownReview.anatomy: Supported arm chains and natural hands; coherent neck/head/torso connection and furniture.
ownReview.identity: Canonical age, facial morphology, hair and costume preserved.
ownReview.screenPlane: All text and diagram components follow monitor plane.
ownReview.palette: Muted sage, charcoal and aged brass.
ownReview.story: Candid work or peer reaction with no camera gaze.

independentReview.notes: Source three-step recurrence table checked. Faces and mouse hand natural, shared screen front visible obliquely to both.
independentReview.alt: Demir and Farah compare a one-unit recurrence and notice the same input produces a different later state.

rootReview.method: Native full-frame review against canonical original portraits and current lesson source. Temporary crops inspected where needed and not retained.

publicationNote: Root verified source and candidate hashes and published after the recorded independent peer review. Active paths replaced in place.
